stemMd: Because the same observation was compatible with either hypothesis, the evidence was ______.
instructionsMd: Select the TWO choices that complete the sentence coherently and give it equivalent meanings.
explanationMd: Evidence that supports more than one interpretation is ambiguous or equivocal. That limitation does not imply the observation was invented or abundant.

distractorRationale.a: Compatibility with both prevents a conclusive distinction.
distractorRationale.d: The quantity of evidence is not specified.
distractorRationale.c: It does not select one hypothesis.
